detail.summary: This synthesis evaluates the reliability of independent judgment versus consensus, noting that intellectual disagreement is structural and subject to post-publication scrutiny.
detail.findings:
Intellectual disagreement is a pervasive, structural feature of high-level domains such as philosophy and law. [source-e530efe561554493]
